items.title: 香港第三季GDP年增5.2% 創5年來前三季最快增速
items.title_en: Hong Kong Q3 GDP Up 5.2% YoY, Fastest Q1‑Q3 Growth in Five Years
paras: 香港官方公布的預估數據顯示，2026年第三季GDP較去年同期成長5.2%，優於市場原先預估的3.6%至3.7%，並較第二季修正後的4.2%顯著加速。這不僅代表香港經濟已連15季保持擴張，累計今年前三季實質GDP年增率更達5.1%，創下5年來同期最快成長紀錄。
經季節調整後，第三季GDP折合季增率為1.9%，相較於第二季的衰退出現明顯回升。香港經濟成長動能主要受惠於商品出口加速擴張，以及本地內需的穩健支撐。
外需方面，在全球對人工智慧(AI)相關電子產品需求強勁的推動下，香港第三季商品出口總額較去年同期大幅暴增30.4%，成長幅度高於第二季的28.9%與第一季的23.8%；商品進口年增率同步上升至29.9%；服務輸出則成長4.3%。
在投資與政府支出方面，第三季本地固定資本形成總額年增7.3%，增速較第二季的3.7%大幅提升接近一倍；政府消費支出也由第二季的停滯狀態回升至年增1.7%。
內需市場同樣表現平穩，第三季私人消費支出年增2.8%。此外，9月零售業銷售總額達到334億港元，年增6.4%，優於市場預測的4.7%，並連續17個月呈現正成長；累計今年前九個月，零售銷售總額價值較去年同期成長8.3%。
針對未來經濟前景，香港政府發言人指出，全球AI投資持續熱絡，將繼續為香港的貨物出口提供有力支撐。同時，訪港旅遊業持續成長、跨境交通活絡以及金融市場交易熱絡，也將推動服務輸出，使整體經濟保持成長動能。
發言人又表示，政府將密切關注外部環境的不確定性，包含中東地緣政治緊張局勢，以及主要中央銀行維持緊縮貨幣政策的後續影響。
香港財政司司長陳茂波則對市場展望表達積極態度。陳茂波指出，香港第三季經濟成長動能持續，推動成長的三大支柱均呈擴張態勢，其中投資強勁成長反映出投資者對香港經濟前景抱持更樂觀態度。
陳茂波預估，今年香港房地產市場的住宅價格有機會成長7%至10%，且核心商業區的辦公室租金與出租率均已出現改善趨勢。
paras_en: Hong Kong’s official estimate shows that GDP in the third quarter of 2026 grew 5.2% year‑on‑year, beating the market’s original forecast of 3.6%‑3.7% and accelerating sharply from the revised 4.2% in the second quarter. This marks the 15th consecutive quarter of expansion, and the cumulative real GDP growth for the first three quarters of the year reached 5.1%, the fastest pace for the same period in five years.

Seasonally adjusted, the third‑quarter GDP translates to a quarterly growth rate of 1.9%, a clear rebound from the contraction seen in the second quarter. The momentum of Hong Kong’s economy is mainly driven by a rapid expansion in goods exports and solid support from domestic demand.

On the external side, strong global demand for AI‑related electronic products propelled a 30.4% year‑on‑year surge in Hong Kong’s total goods exports in the third quarter, outpacing the 28.9% growth in the second quarter and 23.8% in the first quarter; goods imports also rose 29.9% year‑on‑year, while services exports grew 4.3%.

In terms of investment and government spending, local fixed capital formation rose 7.3% year‑on‑year in the third quarter, nearly double the 3.7% growth recorded in the second quarter; government consumption expenditure also rebounded from a flat second quarter to a 1.7% year‑on‑year increase.

The domestic market remained stable, with private consumption spending up 2.8% year‑on‑year in the third quarter. In addition, September retail sales totaled HK$33.4 billion, up 6.4% year‑on‑year, beating the market’s 4.7% forecast and marking the 17th consecutive month of growth; for the first nine months of the year, total retail sales were 8.3% higher than a year earlier.

Regarding the outlook, a Hong Kong government spokesperson said that continued global AI investment will keep providing strong support for the city’s goods exports. Ongoing growth in inbound tourism, active cross‑border transport and vibrant financial market trading will also boost services exports, sustaining overall economic momentum.

The spokesperson added that the government will closely monitor external uncertainties, including heightened geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and the downstream effects of major central banks maintaining tight monetary policies.

Financial Secretary Paul Chan expressed a positive market outlook, noting that Hong Kong’s third‑quarter growth momentum remains robust, with all three growth pillars—investment, consumption and external demand—expanding, and that strong investment growth reflects investors’ increasingly optimistic view of Hong Kong’s economic prospects.

Chan projected that Hong Kong’s residential property prices could rise 7%‑10% this year, and that office rents and vacancy rates in the core business districts are already showing signs of improvement.

items.title: 三星德州二廠傳產能已訂滿！超微拿下多數產能 輝達也下單
items.title_en: Samsung Texas Second Plant Capacity Fully Booked; AMD Secures Majority, Nvidia Also Places Orders
paras: 南韓《每日經濟新聞》周二(3日)引述業界消息指出，三星電子(005930-KS)位於美國德州泰勒市的第二座晶圓代工廠預定11月初正式動工，產能已全數訂滿。新廠將採用2奈米製程，為超微(AMD-US)與輝達(NVDA-US)生產高頻寬記憶體(HBM)所需的基礎晶片，其中多數產量將供應超微。三星對客戶訂單不予置評。
泰勒一廠已取得特斯拉(TSLA-US)的晶片代工合約，二廠則以AI加速器所需的記憶體零組件為主。據報導，二廠面積約270萬平方英尺(約25萬平方公尺)，約為一廠的1.5倍。目前廠區已展開整地等前置作業，預計自2029年2月起安裝生產設備，目標2030年量產。
三星規劃在德州生產的基礎晶片，位於多層堆疊的動態隨機存取記憶體(DRAM)底部，負責在記憶體與圖形處理器(GPU)之間傳輸資料，其設計影響HBM的速度與耗電量。三星目前量產的HBM4採用4奈米基礎晶片，未來則計劃將泰勒二廠生產的2奈米基礎晶片，與南韓製造的DRAM晶片堆疊組合，再以完整的HBM產品交付客戶。
超微占泰勒二廠目前訂單的大多數，至於三星能否進一步擴大輝達訂單，仍取決於下一代產品的代工安排。《每日經濟新聞》指出，輝達希望將旗下客製化記憶體NVHBM的基礎晶片集中委由台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)生產，以縮小不同供應商之間的效能差異，並簡化驗證程序。據報三星正評估自家製程能否生產這類晶片，以便在台積電產能不足時承接訂單。
paras_en: South Korea’s Daily Economic News reported on Tuesday (the 3rd) that Samsung Electronics (005930‑KS) plans to break ground on its second wafer‑fab in Taylor, Texas, in early November, and the entire capacity has already been booked. The new plant will use a 2‑nanometer process to produce the base chips needed for high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) for AMD (AMD‑US) and Nvidia (NVDA‑US), with most of the output slated for AMD. Samsung declined to comment on customer orders.

The Taylor‑1 fab has already secured a chip‑manufacturing contract with Tesla (TSLA‑US), while the second fab will focus on memory components required for AI accelerators. Reported to be about 2.7 million square feet (≈250,000 m²)—roughly 1.5 times the size of the first plant—the site is currently undergoing site‑preparation work, with equipment installation expected to begin in February 2029 and volume production targeted for 2030.

Samsung’s planned base chips in Texas sit at the bottom of the multi‑layer stacked dynamic random‑access memory (DRAM) stack and handle data transfer between the memory and graphics processing units (GPUs). Their design influences HBM speed and power consumption. Samsung currently mass‑produces HBM4 using 4‑nm base chips, and intends to use the 2‑nm base chips from the Taylor‑2 fab stacked with DRAM chips made in South Korea to deliver complete HBM products to customers.

AMD accounts for the majority of current orders at the Taylor‑2 fab. Whether Samsung can further expand Nvidia’s orders will depend on the next‑generation product’s fab arrangements. The Daily Economic News noted that Nvidia wants to concentrate production of its custom memory NVHBM base chips at TSMC (2330‑TW)(TSM‑US) to reduce performance variance across suppliers and simplify validation. Samsung is reportedly evaluating whether its own process can produce such chips to capture orders if TSMC capacity falls short.

items.title: 賴清德：台股已躍升全球第四大市場 揭未來金融服務三大發展方向
items.title_en: Lai Ching-te: Taiwan Stock Market Rises to World’s Fourth Largest, Unveils Three Future Financial Service Development Directions
paras: 總統賴清德今(3)日出席「2026台灣週」開幕式時表示，面對國際情勢變化及AI挑戰，政府將持續發揮產業優勢、強化金融發展，讓金融市場更加國際化、資本市場更具創新活力，讓台灣成為更值得長期信賴的投資市場，今(2026)年依照彭博統計，台股已躍升為全球第四大股市，資本市場將持續擴大。
賴清德表示，去年第一屆台灣週成功匯聚許多國內外金融機構與國際投資人；今年以「從科技島到資本島」為主題，擴大舉辦一系列國際金融交流活動，展現台灣金融市場的發展成果，向世界分享台灣下一階段的金融發展願景。
賴清德指出，近年面對國際變化及AI浪潮的挑戰，台灣經濟展現韌性，去(2025)年台灣經濟成長率達到8.76%，預估今年全年可超過11%，主計總處上周五公布，今年第3季經濟成長率為14.36%，比8月預測增加2.94個百分點，創48年來同季最高，並已連4季雙位數成長。
賴清德認為，產業發展需要金融服務，產業的全球布局更需要具有國際競爭力的金融市場做為後盾，政府會持續朝三個方向，發揮產業優勢，也強化金融發展。
第一，讓台灣的金融市場更加國際化。台灣正積極打造亞洲資產管理中心，讓臺灣成為全球資產配置的重要據點，過去2年多，金管會已經完成超過60項法規函令調適，截至9月底，台灣金融業的資產管理規模已達新台幣48.38兆元，相較於2024年6月增加超過15兆元。
高雄資產管理專區也已吸引62家金融機構進駐，逐步發展跨境金融、家族辦公室及多元資產管理服務。下一步將持續推動金融開放、深化跨境服務及國際市場合作，吸引更多國際資產管理機構與專業人才，讓台灣成為國際資本參與亞洲成長機會的重要平台。
第二，讓台灣的資本市場更具創新活力。台灣優勢不只是能夠提供資金，更重要的是能結合資本、技術與完整的產業供應鏈，持續推動創新板改革，放寬上市與交易制度，讓具有創新能力及成長潛力的企業，有機會透過資本市場取得資金，目標讓台灣成為亞洲創新籌資平台。
第三，讓台灣成為更值得長期信賴的投資市場。持續強化公司治理與永續資訊揭露，並從今年開始分階段接軌IFRS永續揭露準則，讓企業資訊更透明、更具國際可比較性。
賴清德表示，金融發展的成果應該讓更多人民共享，目前已經推出台灣個人投資儲蓄帳戶TISA，已有超過28萬人開戶，未來將加入租稅誘因，鼓勵國人以小額、長期、紀律性的方式參與投資，累積退休資產。讓資本支持創新、讓企業創造成長、讓成長果實由更多人共享。
賴清德指出，過去台灣以科技實力參與全球經濟，未來希望以金融實力連結全球資本、支持創新，與世界共同進步成長。
paras_en: President Lai Ching-te said at the opening of "Taiwan Week 2026" that in response to changing international conditions and AI challenges, the government will continue to leverage industrial strengths and strengthen financial development, making the financial market more international and the capital market more innovative, positioning Taiwan as a trustworthy long‑term investment market. According to Bloomberg, Taiwan’s stock market has risen to the world’s fourth‑largest this year, and the capital market will keep expanding.

Lai noted that last year’s inaugural Taiwan Week successfully gathered many domestic and foreign financial institutions and international investors; this year, under the theme "From a Technology Island to a Capital Island," a series of international financial exchange activities will be expanded to showcase Taiwan’s financial market achievements and share the next stage of its development vision with the world.

He pointed out that amid recent international shifts and the AI wave, Taiwan’s economy has shown resilience, achieving an 8.76% growth rate in 2025 and is projected to exceed 11% for the full year. The Directorate‑General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics reported last Friday that Q3 growth was 14.36%, 2.94 percentage points higher than the August forecast, the highest seasonal growth in 48 years and the fourth consecutive quarter of double‑digit growth.

Lai said industrial development needs financial services, and global industry deployment requires a competitively international financial market as a backstop. The government will pursue three directions to harness industrial advantages while strengthening finance.

First, make Taiwan’s financial market more international. Taiwan is actively building an Asian asset‑management hub to become a key global asset‑allocation point. Over the past two years, the Financial Supervisory Commission has adjusted more than 60 regulations; by the end of September, the asset‑management scale of Taiwan’s financial sector reached NT$48.38 trillion, up over NT$15 trillion since June 2024.

The Kaohsiung Asset‑Management Zone has attracted 62 financial institutions, gradually developing cross‑border finance, family offices and diversified asset‑management services. The next steps include further financial opening, deepening cross‑border services and international market cooperation to draw more global asset‑management firms and talent, making Taiwan a key platform for international capital to tap Asian growth opportunities.

Second, inject more innovation into Taiwan’s capital market. Taiwan’s advantage lies not only in providing capital but also in combining capital, technology and a complete industry supply chain. Ongoing reforms of the Innovation Board and relaxed listing and trading rules will give innovative, high‑growth companies better access to funding, aiming to make Taiwan an Asian hub for innovative financing.

Third, make Taiwan a more trustworthy long‑term investment market. Efforts will continue to strengthen corporate governance and sustainability disclosures, and from this year the market will gradually align with IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards, enhancing transparency and international comparability of corporate information.

Lai said the benefits of financial development should be shared widely. Taiwan’s Personal Investment Savings Account (TISA) has already attracted over 280,000 account holders; future tax incentives will encourage citizens to invest modestly, regularly and disciplinedly to build retirement assets, letting capital support innovation, companies grow, and more people share the fruits of growth.

He concluded that while Taiwan has historically contributed to the global economy through its technology strength, the future goal is to connect global capital with Taiwan’s financial strength, supporting innovation and advancing together with the world.

items.title: 環球晶擬發行5億美元私募可轉債 美光全數認購
items.title_en: GlobalWafers Plans $500 Million Private Placement Convertible Bonds, Micron to Subscribe Entirely
paras: 矽晶圓大廠環球晶(6488-TW)深化與美國記憶體大廠美光(Micron)(MU-US)策略合作，董事會今(3)日決議通過，擬於5億美元額度內發行10年期私募無擔保可轉換公司債，票面年利率0.5%，並由美光擔任唯一應募人。此次資金合作將結合雙方規劃的10年期長期供應協議(LTA)，進一步強化環球晶美國在地製造布局及先進半導體晶圓供應能力。
環球晶指出，此次私募可轉債是雙方今年7月宣布合作時提及的策略性資金支持進一步推進，透過長期供應與資金合作雙軌並行，將合作關係從既有產品供需延伸至策略性資金合作及長期供應鏈布局，涵蓋未來產能配置、供應穩定性及先進半導體材料供應體系發展。
環球晶表示，私募可轉債除可提供長期資金，也有助於增加資本結構彈性，支持公司美國業務發展及先進晶圓供應能力提升，同時強化美國在地關鍵材料供應能力與供應鏈韌性。
在美國布局方面，環球晶多年來積極推進全球先進製造布局，其中位於美國德州的新廠GlobalWafers America，出貨量已連續4個月創下新高，逐步展現前期投資成果。環球晶指出，結合美國在地製造能力，以及橫跨亞洲、美洲與歐洲的全球製造網絡，可建構更貼近市場、滿足多元客戶需求的供應體系，此次與美光的策略合作，也將進一步銜接客戶長期需求與在地製造布局。
環球晶董事長暨執行長徐秀蘭表示，半導體產業技術創新加速，但支撐創新的先進製造能力，仍需要跨越產業週期持續投入。具備競爭力的供應鏈不僅要回應當前市場需求，也必須提前布局未來技術發展與產能需求。此次與美光深化合作，體現雙方長期累積的互信基礎，也反映半導體產業價值鏈正從傳統供需合作，進一步邁向長期策略協作。
環球晶表示，本次私募可轉債案仍須提交股東會決議，待股東會通過後，將授權董事會視市場狀況及公司營運需求，自股東會決議日起一年內一次辦理，實際發行條件及時程將依後續程序辦理。
paras_en: GlobalWafers (6488-TW), a major silicon wafer manufacturer, deepened its strategic partnership with U.S. memory giant Micron (MU-US). The board resolved today (the 3rd) to issue a 10‑year unsecured private‑placement convertible bond within a $500 million limit, bearing a 0.5% annual coupon, with Micron as the sole subscriber. The financing will be tied to a 10‑year long‑term supply agreement (LTA) the two companies are planning, further strengthening GlobalWafers' U.S. manufacturing footprint and its capacity to supply advanced semiconductor wafers.

GlobalWafers noted that the private‑placement convertible bond is the strategic capital support mentioned when the partnership was announced in July. By pursuing parallel long‑term supply and financing tracks, the collaboration will expand from existing product supply to strategic funding and long‑term supply‑chain planning, covering future capacity allocation, supply stability and the development of advanced semiconductor material supply systems.

GlobalWafers said the private‑placement convertible bond will not only provide long‑term funding but also increase flexibility in its capital structure, supporting the growth of its U.S. business and enhancing its advanced wafer supply capabilities, while bolstering local key‑material supply and supply‑chain resilience in the United States.

Regarding its U.S. footprint, GlobalWafers has been actively advancing its global advanced manufacturing network for years. Its new plant in Texas, GlobalWafers America, has posted record shipments for four consecutive months, gradually demonstrating the payoff of early investments. The company said that combining local U.S. manufacturing capacity with a worldwide network spanning Asia, the Americas and Europe enables a supply system that is closer to the market and can meet diverse customer needs; the strategic partnership with Micron will further align long‑term customer demand with local manufacturing deployment.

Chairman and CEO Hsu Hsiu‑lan said that while technological innovation in the semiconductor industry is accelerating, the advanced manufacturing capability that underpins that innovation still requires sustained investment across industry cycles. A competitive supply chain must not only meet current market demand but also anticipate future technology development and capacity needs. Deepening cooperation with Micron reflects the long‑term trust built between the two firms and signals that the semiconductor value chain is moving from traditional supply‑demand cooperation toward long‑term strategic collaboration.

GlobalWafers said the private‑placement convertible bond still requires shareholder approval. Once approved, the board will be authorized, based on market conditions and operational needs, to execute the issuance within one year of the shareholder meeting. The actual issuance terms and timeline will be determined through subsequent procedures.

items.title: 〈環球晶法說〉前三季EPS 15元、上半年擬配息6元 美國12吋SOI需求超預期評估再擴產
items.title_en: GlobalWafers Earnings Call: Q3 EPS NT$15, H1 Dividend Proposal NT$6, US 12-inch SOI Demand Exceeds Expectations Prompting Capacity Expansion
paras: 矽晶圓廠環球晶(6488-TW)今(3)日召開法說並公告第三季財報，稅後純益15.05億元，季減6成、年減23.6%，每股純益3.13元，累計前三季稅後純益71.8億元，年增4成，每股純益15元，已接近2025年全年15.29元的水準。
另外，公司董事會也通過2026年上半年盈餘分派案，每股稅後純益11.87元，每股擬配發6元現金股利，配發總額約31.69億元，除息基準日為2027年1月4日，股利發放日為2027年1月22日。
環球晶第三季營收148.71億元，季減2.3%、年增2.6%；毛利率20%，季減0.06個百分點、年增1.6個百分點、營業利益率9.8%，季增0.4個百分點、年增1.3個百分點。累計前三季營收440.7億元，年減4.4%，毛利率20.5%，年減3.1個百分點、營業利益率9.9%，年減3.7個百分點。
環球晶第三季營運雖受到義大利廠8吋產線火災影響，營收較第二季小幅下滑，但全球其他主要生產據點表現持續提升，多項營收及出貨指標創下新高。其中，美國德州新廠出貨量連續四個月刷新紀錄，隨著客戶認證及量產持續推進，在地晶圓需求已高於現有產能。
美國密蘇里州廠方面，12吋SOI第三季產出創歷史新高，受惠RF-SOI、矽光子及功率元件需求成長，目前客戶需求已超過既有擴產規劃，環球晶正加速產能爬坡，並依據客戶需求及長期合作基礎，評估下一階段擴產計畫，同時透過長約安排提高未來需求能見度。
歐洲及日本廠區也有進展，義大利Novara新建12吋產線持續提升產能及推進客戶認證，量產出貨穩步成長，並連續數月創新高；日本宇都宮廠產能利用率維持高檔，第三季出貨量再創新高，新潟廠第三季營收也刷新歷史紀錄，並已連續數季成長。
環球晶指出，AI、高頻寬記憶體(HBM)及先進運算需求持續成長，帶動半導體市場復甦逐步從先進製程擴展至電源管理、資料傳輸等成熟製程應用，加上先進封裝技術演進進一步提高晶圓使用量，使半導體材料需求成長更具廣度與延續性。
此外，全球半導體業者積極推動長期擴產計畫，建廠成本、設備交期及客戶認證門檻同步提高，具備量產能力及客戶認證基礎的矽晶圓供應商，策略價值也持續提升。面對關稅政策及國際貿易環境變化，環球晶已在亞洲、美洲及歐洲建立製造與服務網絡，透過多元產品組合及跨廠協作，提供貼近客戶的一站式解決方案，並藉由既有產能及客戶合作基礎，因應區域供應需求與全球供應鏈調整。
在資本布局方面，環球晶於今年9月完成全球存託憑證(GDR)發行，募資總額約14.32億美元，認購需求約為發行規模的四倍，也是歷來規模第三大的台灣海外存託憑證發行案。本次募資將用於支應原幣購料及海外子公司產能擴充，進一步強化財務結構與資金彈性，支應全球產能布局及後續成長需求。
展望後市，環球晶看好，AI應用持續擴展、半導體需求復甦及全球供應鏈區域化趨勢，將為矽晶圓市場帶來長期成長機會，未來將結合全球產能布局、跨洲服務網絡及GDR募資挹注的財務彈性，持續提升營運效率與供應韌性，掌握下一階段產業成長機會。
paras_en: GlobalWafers (6488-TW) held an earnings call today (the 3rd) and announced its Q3 financial results, reporting a net profit after tax of NT$1.505 billion, down 60% quarter‑over‑quarter and 23.6% year‑over‑year. Earnings per share were NT$3.13. Cumulative net profit for the first three quarters was NT$7.18 billion, up 40% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$15, close to the projected NT$15.29 for the full year 2025.

The board also approved a dividend plan for the first half of 2026: with net profit after tax of NT$11.87 per share, a cash dividend of NT$6 per share will be distributed, amounting to about NT$3.169 billion in total. The ex‑dividend date is set for January 4 2027 and the dividend payment date for January 22 2027.

Q3 revenue was NT$14.871 billion, down 2.3% quarter‑over‑quarter but up 2.6% year‑over‑year; gross margin was 20%, down 0.06 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter but up 1.6 points year‑over‑year, and operating margin was 9.8%, up 0.4 points quarter‑over‑quarter and 1.3 points year‑over‑year. For the first three quarters, cumulative revenue was NT$44.07 billion, down 4.4% year‑over‑year, with a gross margin of 20.5% (down 3.1 points) and operating margin of 9.9% (down 3.7 points).

Although Q3 operations were slightly impacted by a fire at the 8‑inch line in the Italian plant, causing a modest revenue dip from Q2, other major global sites continued to improve, setting new highs for several revenue and shipment metrics. Notably, the new plant in Texas, USA, posted record shipments for four consecutive months, and as customer qualification and volume production progress, local wafer demand now exceeds existing capacity.

At the Missouri plant in the United States, Q3 output of 12‑inch SOI wafers reached a historic high, driven by growth in RF‑SOI, silicon photonics and power‑device demand. Customer demand already surpasses the current expansion plan, prompting GlobalWafers to accelerate capacity ramp‑up and, based on customer needs and long‑term partnerships, evaluate the next phase of expansion while securing future demand visibility through long‑term contracts.

European and Japanese sites also showed progress. The new 12‑inch line at Novara, Italy, continues to increase capacity and advance customer qualification, with steady growth in volume production and consecutive months of record shipments. In Japan, the Utsunomiya plant maintained a high utilization rate and posted a new‑high shipment volume in Q3, while the Niigata plant achieved record Q3 revenue and has posted growth for several consecutive quarters.

GlobalWafers noted that ongoing growth in AI, high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) and advanced computing drives a semiconductor market recovery that is expanding from advanced nodes into mature processes such as power management and data transmission. Advances in advanced packaging further raise wafer usage, broadening and sustaining demand for semiconductor materials.

Furthermore, worldwide semiconductor companies are actively pursuing long‑term capacity expansions, raising plant‑building costs, equipment lead times and customer qualification thresholds. Silicon wafer suppliers with proven mass‑production capability and customer qualification enjoy rising strategic value. Facing tariff policies and shifting international trade conditions, GlobalWafers has built manufacturing and service networks across Asia, the Americas and Europe, offering one‑stop, customer‑centric solutions through a diversified product mix and cross‑fab collaboration, leveraging existing capacity and customer relationships to meet regional supply needs and adjust to global supply‑chain changes.

In terms of capital strategy, GlobalWafers completed a global depositary receipt (GDR) issuance in September this year, raising approximately US$1.432 billion, with subscription demand about four times the offering size, making it the third‑largest overseas GDR issuance ever by a Taiwanese company. The proceeds will be used for foreign‑currency material purchases and capacity expansion at overseas subsidiaries, further strengthening the financial structure and liquidity to support global capacity deployment and future growth needs.

Looking ahead, GlobalWafers is optimistic that continued AI application expansion, semiconductor demand recovery and the regionalization of global supply chains will create long‑term growth opportunities for the silicon wafer market. The company will combine its worldwide capacity footprint, cross‑continental service network and the financial flexibility provided by the GDR raise to keep improving operational efficiency and supply resilience, positioning itself to capture the next phase of industry growth.

items.title: 金管會：永豐網銀異常盜轉4000多萬元、419人受害 11/12前須交報告
items.title_en: Financial Supervisory Commission: Yongfeng Online Bank Unauthorized Transfer of Over NT$40 Million, 419 Victims; Report Due by Nov 12
paras: 永豐銀行今(3)日驚傳重大資安事件，用戶在未開啟 App、亦未進行雙重驗證的情況下，帳戶無預警被盜轉 10 萬元至台北富邦銀行特定帳戶。金管會證實已收到永豐銀行電話通報，初步調查受影響筆數達 427 筆、受害客戶共 419 人，涉及總金額高達 4,000 多萬元。該行將會通報重大偶發事件，依規定，須在通報後次日起，於 7 個營業日內函報詳細資料，也就是要在 11 月 12 日前提交報告。
金管會銀行局副局長王允中表示，金管會大約於今天接近中午時接獲永豐銀行電話通報，經初步比對發現，所有異常交易的資金均被匯入同業(北富銀)的「同一個帳戶」。北富銀對此回應，目前已暫時凍結該收款帳戶，確認入帳款項並未流出，後續將積極配合警方調查與法令作業，協助辦理款項返還事宜。
王允中說明，此案受影響筆數 427 筆、受害客戶共計 419 人，每筆約10萬元，涉及總金額高達 4,000 多萬元。
外界質疑是否為生物辨識遭到破解，以及傳出受害者多為「雲林人(身分證P開頭)」等情況，金管會回應，詳細發生原因與細節目前仍待釐清，永豐銀行須依「重大偶發事件」規定，於 7 日內提出完整清查與檢討報告。
外傳先前有一家外商銀行與一家本土銀行也有用戶受害，盜領手法雷同，不過，金管會澄清，截至記者會前，並未收到其他銀行的通報。
永豐銀行對外說明指出，今日內部發現「新網銀交易系統」程式異常，進而造成部分帳戶不明轉出。永豐銀目前已掌握原因並暫停新版行動銀行 App 服務，引導有自動化交易需求的客戶改用舊版 App 或 ATM 操作。為保障客戶權益，永豐銀已採取代墊款方式，將受影響的本金及手續費等款項全數返還予客戶。
警政署刑事警察局表示，經洽永豐銀行查證屬實後，已請業者稽核查明並提供資料以協助釐清犯罪情形。由於許多受害民眾紛紛向警方及 165 反詐專線報案，各縣市警察局(包含雲林縣)都已陸續接獲民眾報案，全案目前先朝「妨害電腦使用罪」方向深入偵辦。
paras_en: Yongfeng Bank reported a major cybersecurity incident today, where users’ accounts were transferred NT$100,000 each to a specific account at Taipei Fubon Bank without the app being opened or two‑factor authentication being used. The Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) confirmed it received the bank’s phone notification; preliminary investigation shows 427 affected transactions involving 419 customers, with a total amount exceeding NT$40 million. The bank will file a major incidental event report and, according to regulations, must submit detailed information within seven business days after the notification, i.e., by November 12.

FSC Banking Bureau Deputy Director Wang Yunzho said the commission received Yongfeng Bank’s call around noon today and, after an initial comparison, found that all abnormal transaction funds were transferred into the same account at a peer bank (North‑Fubon Bank). North‑Fubon Bank responded that it has temporarily frozen the receiving account, confirmed that the deposited funds have not been moved out, and will cooperate actively with police investigations and legal procedures to assist in the return of the money.
Wang explained that the case involves 427 transactions affecting 419 customers, each about NT$100,000, for a total amount exceeding NT$40 million.

External observers questioned whether biometric authentication had been compromised and reported that many victims have ID numbers starting with “P” from Yunlin County. The FSC replied that the exact cause and details are still being clarified, and Yongfeng Bank must submit a complete investigation and review report within seven days as required for a major incidental event.

It was rumored that a foreign bank and a domestic bank also had victims with similar theft methods, but the FSC clarified that, as of the press conference, it had not received any notifications from other banks.

Yongfeng Bank explained that it discovered a program anomaly in its new online banking transaction system today, which caused some accounts to transfer funds without authorization. The bank has identified the cause, suspended the new mobile banking app, and is directing customers who need automated transactions to use the old app or ATMs. To protect customers, Yongfeng Bank has reimbursed the affected principal amounts and fees in full through a advance‑payment method.

The National Police Agency’s Criminal Investigation Bureau said that after confirming the facts with Yongfeng Bank, it has asked the institution to audit and provide data to help clarify the crime. Because many victims have reported the incident to the police and the 165 anti‑fraud hotline, police departments across counties—including Yunlin—have received reports, and the case is currently being investigated primarily as a violation of the Computer‑Use Interference Act.

items.title: 華爾街憂未來兩年華府陷「政治僵局」 加劇科技股賣壓
items.title_en: Wall Street fears a two‑year political deadlock in Washington will heighten tech‑stock selling pressure
paras: 那斯達克 100 指數跌幅已自高點回檔逾 10%，正式跌入技術性修正區間。市場除了對人工智慧(AI)龐大資本支出的回報速度產生疑慮外，美國期中選舉引發的政治不確定性，也成為重壓華爾街大盤的主因。
市場分析機構 The Kobeissi Letter 於社群平台 X 發文表示，科技股的拋售潮「絕非僅是技術性修正」，投資人正逐步反映未來兩年華府可能出現的「政治僵局」。據預測平台 Polymarket 數據顯示，民主黨掌控眾議院與參議院的機率分別高達 95% 與 77%。
面對國會變天疑慮，美國總統川普已公開示警，若共和黨失去眾議院多數，他將轉變為頻繁行使否決權的「否決先生(Mr. Veto)」。The Kobeissi Letter 強調，「市場極度厭惡不確定性」，川普的表態為未來兩年的政局埋下隱憂。
除了政局變數外，科技巨擘的財報表現並未能安撫市場。Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 因廣告與搜尋業務營收不如預期，創下單日最大跌幅，Meta (META-US)與 Amazon(AMZN-US) 股價均受拖累，英特爾(INTC-US)與 ServiceNow (NOW-US)等業者更因財測失利出現歷史性重挫。
James Investment Research 投資組合經理 Brian Culpepper 對此分析指出：「投資人對於這些企業無休止的巨額支出感到焦慮。我不認為 AI 投資熱潮已經破滅，但它確實走得太快了。」
儘管那斯達克 100 指數單月市值蒸發近 2 兆美元，但多數機構對期中選舉後的長期走勢仍抱持正面態度。摩根士丹利策略師 Mike Wilson 將此次選舉視為能消除市場不確定性的「清算事件」，無論哪個黨派獲勝，都可能對股市有所幫助。
Carson Investment Research 分析師 Ryan Detrick 補充，自 1950 年以來，標普 500 指數在期中選舉後的 11 月至次年 4 月期間全數上漲。富達投資(Fidelity Investments)數據顯示，1938 年以來期中選舉後 12 個月標普 500 指數上漲機率高達 95%。
paras_en: The Nasdaq‑100 index has fallen more than 10% from its recent high, officially entering a technical correction zone. In addition to doubts about the speed of returns on the massive AI capital spending, political uncertainty sparked by the U.S. midterm elections has become a major drag on Wall Street’s broad market.

Market‑analysis firm The Kobeissi Letter posted on X that the tech‑stock sell‑off “is far from being just a technical correction”; investors are gradually pricing in a possible “political deadlock” in Washington over the next two years. Data from the prediction platform Polymarket shows a 95% chance that Democrats will control the House and a 77% chance they will control the Senate.

Facing concerns about a shift in Congress, former President Donald Trump has publicly warned that if Republicans lose the House majority, he will become a frequent user of the veto, dubbing himself “Mr. Veto.” The Kobeissi Letter stresses that “the market loathes uncertainty,” and Trump’s stance adds a lingering risk to the political outlook for the next two years.

Beyond the political variables, the earnings reports of tech giants have failed to soothe the market. Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) posted its biggest one‑day drop after advertising and search revenues fell short of expectations, while Meta (META‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US) stocks were also dragged down. Intel (INTC‑US) and ServiceNow (NOW‑US) suffered historic declines after disappointing forecasts.

James Investment Research portfolio manager Brian Culpepper analyzed, “Investors are anxious about these companies’ endless massive spending. I don’t think the AI investment boom is over, but it certainly moved too fast.”

Although the Nasdaq‑100’s market cap evaporated nearly $2 trillion this month, most institutions remain upbeat about the long‑term trajectory after the midterms. Morgan Stanley strategist Mike Wilson views the election as a “clearing event” that could remove market uncertainty, and regardless of which party wins, it may ultimately benefit equities.

Carson Investment Research analyst Ryan Detrick added that since 1950 the S&P 500 has risen in every November‑to‑April period following a midterm election. Fidelity Investments data shows that since 1938 the probability of the S&P 500 gaining over the 12 months after a midterm is as high as 95%.

items.title: 中裕全力推進長效愛滋雙抗體新藥臨床2b試驗 今年底前取得期中結果
items.title_en: Zhongyu Accelerates Long-Acting Dual Antibody HIV Drug Clinical Phase 2b Trial, Aims for Mid‑term Results by Year‑End
paras: 中裕(4147-TW)今(3)日指出，目前全力推進長效愛滋雙抗體組合新藥TMB-365/TMB-380的臨床2b試驗，預計今年底前取得關鍵期中研究結果，將持續尋找潛在合作契機，深化與國際藥廠及研究機構的溝通，加速旗下創新產品及自主平台的全球商業化進程。
中裕積極拓展國際合作，參與國際疫苗學會(ISV)會議、國際感染性疾病學術年會IDWeek 2026，並赴美國國家衛生研究院(NIH)深入參訪與交流。
中裕進一步指出，公司與NIH及國際藥廠的交流中，聚焦中裕旗下CD4標靶抗體技術平台，就愛滋病長效療法與愛滋功能性治癒兩大方向，探討潛在的技術授權、策略夥伴關係及共同研發合作。
另外，中裕也獲邀於IDWeek 2026發表旗下長效抗體維持療法TMB-365/TMB-380臨床與實驗室數據，包括1場專題報告與1場海報展示，並獲得國際醫學界迴響。
執行長張金明指出，近期與國際藥廠及研究機構深入探討，為公司拓展海外授權與共同開發創造更多實質可能性，將持續把自主技術平台轉化為長期商業價值，進一步推動全球布局。
paras_en: Zhongyu (4147‑TW) said today that it is fully advancing the clinical Phase 2b trial of its long‑acting dual‑antibody HIV drug combination TMB‑365/TMB‑380, and expects to obtain key mid‑term study results before the end of this year. The company will continue to seek potential partnership opportunities, deepen communication with international pharmaceutical firms and research institutions, and accelerate the global commercialization of its innovative products and proprietary platforms.

Zhongyu is actively expanding international collaborations, participating in the International Society for Vaccines (ISV) conference, the International Infectious Diseases Academic Conference IDWeek 2026, and conducting in‑depth visits and exchanges at the U.S. National Institutes of Health (NIH).

The company further noted that discussions with NIH and international pharma partners focus on Zhongyu’s CD4‑targeted antibody technology platform, exploring potential technology licensing, strategic partnerships, and joint‑development collaborations for long‑acting HIV therapy and functional HIV cure approaches.

In addition, Zhongyu was invited to present clinical and laboratory data on its long‑acting antibody maintenance therapy TMB‑365/TMB‑380 at IDWeek 2026, delivering one plenary talk and one poster session, which received notable feedback from the international medical community.

CEO Zhang Jin‑ming said that recent deep‑dive talks with overseas pharma companies and research institutions are creating more concrete possibilities for overseas licensing and co‑development, and the company will continue to translate its proprietary technology platform into long‑term commercial value, further advancing its global footprint.

items.title: 賴清德：台股已躍升全球第四大市場 揭未來金融服務三大發展方向
items.title_en: Lai Ching-te: Taiwan Stock Market Rises to World’s Fourth Largest, Unveils Three Future Financial Service Development Directions
paras: 總統賴清德今(3)日出席「2026台灣週」開幕式時表示，面對國際情勢變化及AI挑戰，政府將持續發揮產業優勢、強化金融發展，讓金融市場更加國際化、資本市場更具創新活力，讓台灣成為更值得長期信賴的投資市場，今(2026)年依照彭博統計，台股已躍升為全球第四大股市，資本市場將持續擴大。
賴清德表示，去年第一屆台灣週成功匯聚許多國內外金融機構與國際投資人；今年以「從科技島到資本島」為主題，擴大舉辦一系列國際金融交流活動，展現台灣金融市場的發展成果，向世界分享台灣下一階段的金融發展願景。
賴清德指出，近年面對國際變化及AI浪潮的挑戰，台灣經濟展現韌性，去(2025)年台灣經濟成長率達到8.76%，預估今年全年可超過11%，主計總處上周五公布，今年第3季經濟成長率為14.36%，比8月預測增加2.94個百分點，創48年來同季最高，並已連4季雙位數成長。
賴清德認為，產業發展需要金融服務，產業的全球布局更需要具有國際競爭力的金融市場做為後盾，政府會持續朝三個方向，發揮產業優勢，也強化金融發展。
第一，讓台灣的金融市場更加國際化。台灣正積極打造亞洲資產管理中心，讓臺灣成為全球資產配置的重要據點，過去2年多，金管會已經完成超過60項法規函令調適，截至9月底，台灣金融業的資產管理規模已達新台幣48.38兆元，相較於2024年6月增加超過15兆元。
高雄資產管理專區也已吸引62家金融機構進駐，逐步發展跨境金融、家族辦公室及多元資產管理服務。下一步將持續推動金融開放、深化跨境服務及國際市場合作，吸引更多國際資產管理機構與專業人才，讓台灣成為國際資本參與亞洲成長機會的重要平台。
第二，讓台灣的資本市場更具創新活力。台灣優勢不只是能夠提供資金，更重要的是能結合資本、技術與完整的產業供應鏈，持續推動創新板改革，放寬上市與交易制度，讓具有創新能力及成長潛力的企業，有機會透過資本市場取得資金，目標讓台灣成為亞洲創新籌資平台。
第三，讓台灣成為更值得長期信賴的投資市場。持續強化公司治理與永續資訊揭露，並從今年開始分階段接軌IFRS永續揭露準則，讓企業資訊更透明、更具國際可比較性。
賴清德表示，金融發展的成果應該讓更多人民共享，目前已經推出台灣個人投資儲蓄帳戶TISA，已有超過28萬人開戶，未來將加入租稅誘因，鼓勵國人以小額、長期、紀律性的方式參與投資，累積退休資產。讓資本支持創新、讓企業創造成長、讓成長果實由更多人共享。
賴清德指出，過去台灣以科技實力參與全球經濟，未來希望以金融實力連結全球資本、支持創新，與世界共同進步成長。
paras_en: President Lai Ching-te said at the opening of "Taiwan Week 2026" that in response to changing international conditions and AI challenges, the government will continue to leverage industrial strengths and strengthen financial development, making the financial market more international and the capital market more innovative, positioning Taiwan as a trustworthy long‑term investment market. According to Bloomberg, Taiwan’s stock market has risen to the world’s fourth‑largest this year, and the capital market will keep expanding.

Lai noted that last year’s inaugural Taiwan Week successfully gathered many domestic and foreign financial institutions and international investors; this year, under the theme "From a Technology Island to a Capital Island," a series of international financial exchange activities will be expanded to showcase Taiwan’s financial market achievements and share the next stage of its development vision with the world.

He pointed out that amid recent international shifts and the AI wave, Taiwan’s economy has shown resilience, achieving an 8.76% growth rate in 2025 and is projected to exceed 11% for the full year. The Directorate‑General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics reported last Friday that Q3 growth was 14.36%, 2.94 percentage points higher than the August forecast, the highest seasonal growth in 48 years and the fourth consecutive quarter of double‑digit growth.

Lai said industrial development needs financial services, and global industry deployment requires a competitively international financial market as a backstop. The government will pursue three directions to harness industrial advantages while strengthening finance.

First, make Taiwan’s financial market more international. Taiwan is actively building an Asian asset‑management hub to become a key global asset‑allocation point. Over the past two years, the Financial Supervisory Commission has adjusted more than 60 regulations; by the end of September, the asset‑management scale of Taiwan’s financial sector reached NT$48.38 trillion, up over NT$15 trillion since June 2024.

The Kaohsiung Asset‑Management Zone has attracted 62 financial institutions, gradually developing cross‑border finance, family offices and diversified asset‑management services. The next steps include further financial opening, deepening cross‑border services and international market cooperation to draw more global asset‑management firms and talent, making Taiwan a key platform for international capital to tap Asian growth opportunities.

Second, inject more innovation into Taiwan’s capital market. Taiwan’s advantage lies not only in providing capital but also in combining capital, technology and a complete industry supply chain. Ongoing reforms of the Innovation Board and relaxed listing and trading rules will give innovative, high‑growth companies better access to funding, aiming to make Taiwan an Asian hub for innovative financing.

Third, make Taiwan a more trustworthy long‑term investment market. Efforts will continue to strengthen corporate governance and sustainability disclosures, and from this year the market will gradually align with IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards, enhancing transparency and international comparability of corporate information.

Lai said the benefits of financial development should be shared widely. Taiwan’s Personal Investment Savings Account (TISA) has already attracted over 280,000 account holders; future tax incentives will encourage citizens to invest modestly, regularly and disciplinedly to build retirement assets, letting capital support innovation, companies grow, and more people share the fruits of growth.

He concluded that while Taiwan has historically contributed to the global economy through its technology strength, the future goal is to connect global capital with Taiwan’s financial strength, supporting innovation and advancing together with the world.

items.title: 臺銀連7年稱霸聯貸榜 領軍技嘉500億授信案 支持核心戰略產業
items.title_en: Taiwan Bank Dominates Syndicated Loan Market for 7 Years, Leads Gigabyte's NT$50 Billion Sustainable Credit Deal Supporting Core Strategic Industries
paras: AI 算力狂潮席捲全球，帶動伺服器大廠營運一飛衝天，相關金融聯貸案亦傳出捷報。由臺銀、兆豐銀、華南銀及國泰世華銀行等 4 大銀行統籌主辦的技嘉科技 (2376-TW) 500 億元永續指標連結聯合授信案，於今（3）日順利完成簽約。本案資金將用於償還金融機構借款並充實中期營運周轉金，在 9 家金融機構踴躍參與下實現超額募集，最終以 500 億元圓滿結案，顯示金融市場對技嘉研發實力與 AI 布局的高度的肯定。
本聯合授信案由臺銀董事長凌忠嫄、兆豐銀行副總經理陳建中、國泰世華銀行副總經理林逸群、華南銀行協理徐振南，與技嘉科技董事長葉培城共同主持簽約儀式。本次聯貸由臺銀統籌主辦並擔任額度管理銀行，推出後即獲得各大金融業者熱烈響應，成功達成超額募集，展現銀行團對技嘉經營成果與未來前景的強烈信心。
技嘉近年以全場域 AI 布局為核心發展策略，深耕與 NVIDIA、Intel 及 AMD 等國際晶片大廠的深度合作關係。集團產品線完整，涵蓋 AI 伺服器、資料中心解決方案、AI PC、主機板及顯示卡等多元領域。隨著直接液冷散熱、整機櫃與高效能運算等 AI 基礎建設的持續投入，加上 AI PC 與客製化邊緣運算平台的智慧終端應用，技嘉已成功構建起自雲端資料中心延伸至終端裝置的完整 AI 生態系。
受惠於全球資料中心建置熱潮及 AI 算力需求強勁，技嘉 AI 伺服器業務展現驚人成長力道。公司 2026 年前 9 月合併營收高達 4039.82 億元，年增 63.17%；2026 年上半年稅後淨利則達 131.09 億元，年增 93.92%，營收與獲利同步刷新歷年同期新高紀錄。面對 AI 技術快速普及，技嘉將持續深化軟硬體整合能力，滿足 enterprise 與消費端市場爆發性的應用需求。
除了優異的財務表現，技嘉在 ESG 永續領域的努力同樣顯著。公司自 2019 年起導入「永續基金暨減量獎勵制度」，鼓勵員工參與節能與製程優化提案，不僅在 2024 年提前實現減碳 50% 的目標，2026 年更獲得第 22 屆遠見 ESG 企業永續獎電子科技業首獎。本次聯貸案特別導入永續連結指標，透過具體利率優惠機制支持企業低碳轉型，落實「創新科技，美化人生」的企業宗旨。
作為本次聯貸案的靈魂角色，臺銀秉持「臺灣的靠山、永續的推手」理念，截至 2025 年底已連續 7 年蟬聯台灣聯貸市場統籌主辦行及額度分銷行雙料冠軍。臺銀積極響應政府政策，2026 年第 3 度榮獲「辦理六大核心戰略產業放款方案優等銀行」，並曾獲頒 BSI「ESG永續發展卓越獎」與經濟部「淨零轉型類協助獎」，持續透過綠色金融影響力，陪伴台灣科技巨頭跨足全球競爭舞台。
paras_en: AI computing power is sweeping the globe, propelling server giants to soaring growth and sparking positive news in related syndicated loan deals. A NT$50 billion sustainable performance‑linked joint credit facility for Gigabyte Technology (2376‑TW), coordinated by Taiwan Bank, Mega Bank, Hua Nan Bank and Cathay United Bank, was successfully signed today (the 3rd). The funds will be used to repay existing borrowings and to bolster mid‑term working capital, and with enthusiastic participation from nine financial institutions the loan was oversubscribed, closing at the full NT$50 billion, reflecting strong market confidence in Gigabyte’s R&D strength and AI strategy.

The joint credit agreement was signed in a ceremony attended by Taiwan Bank Chairman Ling Zhongyuan, Mega Bank Deputy General Manager Chen Jian‑zhong, Cathay United Bank Deputy General Manager Lin Yi‑qun, Hua Nan Bank Assistant Manager Xu Zhen‑nan, and Gigabyte Technology Chairman Yeh Pei‑cheng. Taiwan Bank acted as the lead arranger and capacity manager, and the syndicate received an enthusiastic response from the financial community, achieving an oversubscription that demonstrates the banking consortium’s strong confidence in Gigabyte’s performance and future prospects.

In recent years Gigabyte has made an all‑domain AI deployment its core development strategy, deepening collaborations with international chip leaders such as NVIDIA, Intel and AMD. The group’s product portfolio is comprehensive, covering AI servers, data‑center solutions, AI PCs, motherboards and graphics cards. Continuous investment in AI infrastructure—such as direct liquid cooling, chassis‑integrated systems and high‑performance computing—along with smart‑terminal applications like AI PCs and customized edge‑computing platforms, has enabled Gigabyte to build a complete AI ecosystem that extends from cloud data centers to end‑user devices.

Benefiting from the global data‑center build‑out and strong AI compute demand, Gigabyte’s AI server business has shown remarkable growth. The company’s consolidated revenue for the first nine months of 2026 reached NT$403.982 billion, up 63.17% year‑on‑year; net profit after tax for the first half of 2026 was NT$13.109 billion, a 93.92% increase, setting new year‑over‑year highs for both revenue and profit. Facing rapid AI adoption, Gigabyte will continue to deepen its hardware‑software integration capabilities to meet the explosive application demand from enterprise and consumer markets.

Beyond its strong financial results, Gigabyte’s ESG sustainability efforts are also notable. Since 2019 the company has implemented a “Sustainability Fund and Reduction Incentive Program” to encourage employee proposals on energy saving and process optimization, achieving its 2024 carbon‑reduction target of 50% ahead of schedule and winning the 22nd Vision ESG Corporate Sustainability Award for the electronics technology sector in 2026. This loan incorporates a sustainability‑linked performance metric, offering concrete interest‑rate incentives to support the company’s low‑carbon transition and embody its mission of “Innovative Technology, Enriching Lives.”

As the driving force behind the loan, Taiwan Bank upholds the philosophy “Taiwan’s backbone, sustainability’s catalyst.” By the end of 2025 it had consecutively held the dual titles of lead arranger and capacity distributor in Taiwan’s syndicated loan market for seven years. The bank actively aligns with government policies, earning its third “Outstanding Bank for Core Strategic Industry Lending Programs” award in 2026, as well as BSI’s “ESG Sustainable Development Excellence Award” and the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ “Net‑Zero Transition Assistance Award,” continuously leveraging green finance to support Taiwan’s tech giants on the global stage.

items.title: 環球晶擬發行5億美元私募可轉債 美光全數認購
items.title_en: GlobalWafers Plans $500 Million Private Placement Convertible Bonds, Micron to Subscribe Entirely
paras: 矽晶圓大廠環球晶(6488-TW)深化與美國記憶體大廠美光(Micron)(MU-US)策略合作，董事會今(3)日決議通過，擬於5億美元額度內發行10年期私募無擔保可轉換公司債，票面年利率0.5%，並由美光擔任唯一應募人。此次資金合作將結合雙方規劃的10年期長期供應協議(LTA)，進一步強化環球晶美國在地製造布局及先進半導體晶圓供應能力。
環球晶指出，此次私募可轉債是雙方今年7月宣布合作時提及的策略性資金支持進一步推進，透過長期供應與資金合作雙軌並行，將合作關係從既有產品供需延伸至策略性資金合作及長期供應鏈布局，涵蓋未來產能配置、供應穩定性及先進半導體材料供應體系發展。
環球晶表示，私募可轉債除可提供長期資金，也有助於增加資本結構彈性，支持公司美國業務發展及先進晶圓供應能力提升，同時強化美國在地關鍵材料供應能力與供應鏈韌性。
在美國布局方面，環球晶多年來積極推進全球先進製造布局，其中位於美國德州的新廠GlobalWafers America，出貨量已連續4個月創下新高，逐步展現前期投資成果。環球晶指出，結合美國在地製造能力，以及橫跨亞洲、美洲與歐洲的全球製造網絡，可建構更貼近市場、滿足多元客戶需求的供應體系，此次與美光的策略合作，也將進一步銜接客戶長期需求與在地製造布局。
環球晶董事長暨執行長徐秀蘭表示，半導體產業技術創新加速，但支撐創新的先進製造能力，仍需要跨越產業週期持續投入。具備競爭力的供應鏈不僅要回應當前市場需求，也必須提前布局未來技術發展與產能需求。此次與美光深化合作，體現雙方長期累積的互信基礎，也反映半導體產業價值鏈正從傳統供需合作，進一步邁向長期策略協作。
環球晶表示，本次私募可轉債案仍須提交股東會決議，待股東會通過後，將授權董事會視市場狀況及公司營運需求，自股東會決議日起一年內一次辦理，實際發行條件及時程將依後續程序辦理。
paras_en: GlobalWafers (6488-TW), a major silicon wafer manufacturer, deepened its strategic partnership with U.S. memory giant Micron (MU-US). The board resolved today (the 3rd) to issue a 10‑year unsecured private‑placement convertible bond within a $500 million limit, bearing a 0.5% annual coupon, with Micron as the sole subscriber. The financing will be tied to a 10‑year long‑term supply agreement (LTA) the two companies are planning, further strengthening GlobalWafers' U.S. manufacturing footprint and its capacity to supply advanced semiconductor wafers.

GlobalWafers noted that the private‑placement convertible bond is the strategic capital support mentioned when the partnership was announced in July. By pursuing parallel long‑term supply and financing tracks, the collaboration will expand from existing product supply to strategic funding and long‑term supply‑chain planning, covering future capacity allocation, supply stability and the development of advanced semiconductor material supply systems.

GlobalWafers said the private‑placement convertible bond will not only provide long‑term funding but also increase flexibility in its capital structure, supporting the growth of its U.S. business and enhancing its advanced wafer supply capabilities, while bolstering local key‑material supply and supply‑chain resilience in the United States.

Regarding its U.S. footprint, GlobalWafers has been actively advancing its global advanced manufacturing network for years. Its new plant in Texas, GlobalWafers America, has posted record shipments for four consecutive months, gradually demonstrating the payoff of early investments. The company said that combining local U.S. manufacturing capacity with a worldwide network spanning Asia, the Americas and Europe enables a supply system that is closer to the market and can meet diverse customer needs; the strategic partnership with Micron will further align long‑term customer demand with local manufacturing deployment.

Chairman and CEO Hsu Hsiu‑lan said that while technological innovation in the semiconductor industry is accelerating, the advanced manufacturing capability that underpins that innovation still requires sustained investment across industry cycles. A competitive supply chain must not only meet current market demand but also anticipate future technology development and capacity needs. Deepening cooperation with Micron reflects the long‑term trust built between the two firms and signals that the semiconductor value chain is moving from traditional supply‑demand cooperation toward long‑term strategic collaboration.

GlobalWafers said the private‑placement convertible bond still requires shareholder approval. Once approved, the board will be authorized, based on market conditions and operational needs, to execute the issuance within one year of the shareholder meeting. The actual issuance terms and timeline will be determined through subsequent procedures.

items.title: 〈環球晶法說〉前三季EPS 15元、上半年擬配息6元 美國12吋SOI需求超預期評估再擴產
items.title_en: GlobalWafers Earnings Call: Q3 EPS NT$15, H1 Dividend Proposal NT$6, US 12-inch SOI Demand Exceeds Expectations Prompting Capacity Expansion
paras: 矽晶圓廠環球晶(6488-TW)今(3)日召開法說並公告第三季財報，稅後純益15.05億元，季減6成、年減23.6%，每股純益3.13元，累計前三季稅後純益71.8億元，年增4成，每股純益15元，已接近2025年全年15.29元的水準。
另外，公司董事會也通過2026年上半年盈餘分派案，每股稅後純益11.87元，每股擬配發6元現金股利，配發總額約31.69億元，除息基準日為2027年1月4日，股利發放日為2027年1月22日。
環球晶第三季營收148.71億元，季減2.3%、年增2.6%；毛利率20%，季減0.06個百分點、年增1.6個百分點、營業利益率9.8%，季增0.4個百分點、年增1.3個百分點。累計前三季營收440.7億元，年減4.4%，毛利率20.5%，年減3.1個百分點、營業利益率9.9%，年減3.7個百分點。
環球晶第三季營運雖受到義大利廠8吋產線火災影響，營收較第二季小幅下滑，但全球其他主要生產據點表現持續提升，多項營收及出貨指標創下新高。其中，美國德州新廠出貨量連續四個月刷新紀錄，隨著客戶認證及量產持續推進，在地晶圓需求已高於現有產能。
美國密蘇里州廠方面，12吋SOI第三季產出創歷史新高，受惠RF-SOI、矽光子及功率元件需求成長，目前客戶需求已超過既有擴產規劃，環球晶正加速產能爬坡，並依據客戶需求及長期合作基礎，評估下一階段擴產計畫，同時透過長約安排提高未來需求能見度。
歐洲及日本廠區也有進展，義大利Novara新建12吋產線持續提升產能及推進客戶認證，量產出貨穩步成長，並連續數月創新高；日本宇都宮廠產能利用率維持高檔，第三季出貨量再創新高，新潟廠第三季營收也刷新歷史紀錄，並已連續數季成長。
環球晶指出，AI、高頻寬記憶體(HBM)及先進運算需求持續成長，帶動半導體市場復甦逐步從先進製程擴展至電源管理、資料傳輸等成熟製程應用，加上先進封裝技術演進進一步提高晶圓使用量，使半導體材料需求成長更具廣度與延續性。
此外，全球半導體業者積極推動長期擴產計畫，建廠成本、設備交期及客戶認證門檻同步提高，具備量產能力及客戶認證基礎的矽晶圓供應商，策略價值也持續提升。面對關稅政策及國際貿易環境變化，環球晶已在亞洲、美洲及歐洲建立製造與服務網絡，透過多元產品組合及跨廠協作，提供貼近客戶的一站式解決方案，並藉由既有產能及客戶合作基礎，因應區域供應需求與全球供應鏈調整。
在資本布局方面，環球晶於今年9月完成全球存託憑證(GDR)發行，募資總額約14.32億美元，認購需求約為發行規模的四倍，也是歷來規模第三大的台灣海外存託憑證發行案。本次募資將用於支應原幣購料及海外子公司產能擴充，進一步強化財務結構與資金彈性，支應全球產能布局及後續成長需求。
展望後市，環球晶看好，AI應用持續擴展、半導體需求復甦及全球供應鏈區域化趨勢，將為矽晶圓市場帶來長期成長機會，未來將結合全球產能布局、跨洲服務網絡及GDR募資挹注的財務彈性，持續提升營運效率與供應韌性，掌握下一階段產業成長機會。
paras_en: GlobalWafers (6488-TW) held an earnings call today (the 3rd) and announced its Q3 financial results, reporting a net profit after tax of NT$1.505 billion, down 60% quarter‑over‑quarter and 23.6% year‑over‑year. Earnings per share were NT$3.13. Cumulative net profit for the first three quarters was NT$7.18 billion, up 40% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$15, close to the projected NT$15.29 for the full year 2025.

The board also approved a dividend plan for the first half of 2026: with net profit after tax of NT$11.87 per share, a cash dividend of NT$6 per share will be distributed, amounting to about NT$3.169 billion in total. The ex‑dividend date is set for January 4 2027 and the dividend payment date for January 22 2027.

Q3 revenue was NT$14.871 billion, down 2.3% quarter‑over‑quarter but up 2.6% year‑over‑year; gross margin was 20%, down 0.06 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter but up 1.6 points year‑over‑year, and operating margin was 9.8%, up 0.4 points quarter‑over‑quarter and 1.3 points year‑over‑year. For the first three quarters, cumulative revenue was NT$44.07 billion, down 4.4% year‑over‑year, with a gross margin of 20.5% (down 3.1 points) and operating margin of 9.9% (down 3.7 points).

Although Q3 operations were slightly impacted by a fire at the 8‑inch line in the Italian plant, causing a modest revenue dip from Q2, other major global sites continued to improve, setting new highs for several revenue and shipment metrics. Notably, the new plant in Texas, USA, posted record shipments for four consecutive months, and as customer qualification and volume production progress, local wafer demand now exceeds existing capacity.

At the Missouri plant in the United States, Q3 output of 12‑inch SOI wafers reached a historic high, driven by growth in RF‑SOI, silicon photonics and power‑device demand. Customer demand already surpasses the current expansion plan, prompting GlobalWafers to accelerate capacity ramp‑up and, based on customer needs and long‑term partnerships, evaluate the next phase of expansion while securing future demand visibility through long‑term contracts.

European and Japanese sites also showed progress. The new 12‑inch line at Novara, Italy, continues to increase capacity and advance customer qualification, with steady growth in volume production and consecutive months of record shipments. In Japan, the Utsunomiya plant maintained a high utilization rate and posted a new‑high shipment volume in Q3, while the Niigata plant achieved record Q3 revenue and has posted growth for several consecutive quarters.

GlobalWafers noted that ongoing growth in AI, high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) and advanced computing drives a semiconductor market recovery that is expanding from advanced nodes into mature processes such as power management and data transmission. Advances in advanced packaging further raise wafer usage, broadening and sustaining demand for semiconductor materials.

Furthermore, worldwide semiconductor companies are actively pursuing long‑term capacity expansions, raising plant‑building costs, equipment lead times and customer qualification thresholds. Silicon wafer suppliers with proven mass‑production capability and customer qualification enjoy rising strategic value. Facing tariff policies and shifting international trade conditions, GlobalWafers has built manufacturing and service networks across Asia, the Americas and Europe, offering one‑stop, customer‑centric solutions through a diversified product mix and cross‑fab collaboration, leveraging existing capacity and customer relationships to meet regional supply needs and adjust to global supply‑chain changes.

In terms of capital strategy, GlobalWafers completed a global depositary receipt (GDR) issuance in September this year, raising approximately US$1.432 billion, with subscription demand about four times the offering size, making it the third‑largest overseas GDR issuance ever by a Taiwanese company. The proceeds will be used for foreign‑currency material purchases and capacity expansion at overseas subsidiaries, further strengthening the financial structure and liquidity to support global capacity deployment and future growth needs.

Looking ahead, GlobalWafers is optimistic that continued AI application expansion, semiconductor demand recovery and the regionalization of global supply chains will create long‑term growth opportunities for the silicon wafer market. The company will combine its worldwide capacity footprint, cross‑continental service network and the financial flexibility provided by the GDR raise to keep improving operational efficiency and supply resilience, positioning itself to capture the next phase of industry growth.

items.title: 美股盤前／蘋果跌4.5%、Palantir挫6.3%！晶片股反彈，期貨漲跌互見
items.title_en: US Stocks Pre‑Market: Apple Down 4.5%, Palantir Slides 6.3% – Chip Stocks Rebound, Futures Mixed
paras: 2026年11月03日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股週二（3日）盤前，主要指數期貨漲跌互見。蘋果因記憶體成本上升、毛利率承壓，股價下跌4.5%；Palantir(PLTR-US)即使財報與營收展望優於預期，仍下挫6.3%。不過，輝達、AMD等晶片股反彈，支撐那斯達克100期貨走高，市場同時等待美國期中選舉結果。
截稿前，道瓊期貨下跌219點、跌幅0.42%；標普500期貨上漲0.02%，那斯達克100期貨上漲0.46%。
蘋果成為最新一家財報未能帶動股價的大型科技公司。公司警告，記憶體晶片成本將持續上升，壓抑涵蓋年底假期旺季季度的毛利率，盤前股價下跌4.5%。
AI數據分析軟體業者Palantir第3季業績超越市場預期，並預估第4季營收高於分析師預期，但盤前股價仍下跌6.3%，反映投資人對科技股的要求持續提高。
科技股近期承受的壓力，已使那斯達克100指數在週一收盤時，較歷史收盤高點下跌逾10%，進入修正區間。市場日益關注大型科技公司的AI支出快速攀升，能否帶來足夠回報；部分業者透過發債支應投資，也讓借款成本上升下的資金壓力受到檢視。
不過，晶片股週二盤前出現反彈。輝達在連跌四個交易日後上漲1.6%；即將於盤後公布財報的AMD上漲2.8%，Marvell與英特爾也走高。其中，Marvell前一交易日才因宣布收購Lumentum而重挫，盤前走勢暫時回穩。
政治面則聚焦美國期中選舉。民調與無黨派分析人士傾向認為，民主黨有望奪回眾議院，參議院控制權仍有變數。法國興業銀行分析師指出，政府支出與赤字疑慮持續加劇市場波動；若民主黨取得眾議院控制權，未來擴大財政支出的協商可能更加困難。
摩根士丹利分析師則認為，選舉結果出爐有助消除一項重大不確定性，並判斷自6月開始的美股修正已接近尾聲。
此外，原油價格在前一交易日大跌後回升，中東局勢仍是市場變數。財報方面，輝瑞、農產品業者ADM與煉油商Marathon Petroleum預定盤前公布業績；半導體測試設備商Aehr Test Systems與寬頻解決方案業者Harmonic調高全年營收預測後，盤前分別上漲14.6%與16.1%。

paras_en: On Tuesday, November 3, 2026, US equity index futures were mixed in pre‑market trading. Apple fell 4.5% as memory‑chip costs rise and margins come under pressure, while Palantir (PLTR‑US) dropped 6.3% despite earnings and revenue outlook beating expectations. Meanwhile, chip makers such as Nvidia and AMD rebounded, lifting Nasdaq‑100 futures, as the market awaits the outcome of the US midterm elections.
Before the deadline, Dow futures were down 219 points, or 0.42%; S&P 500 futures were up 0.02%; and Nasdaq‑100 futures were up 0.46%.

Apple became the latest large‑cap tech company whose earnings failed to lift the stock. The company warned that memory‑chip costs will continue to rise, suppressing margins for the quarter that includes the holiday season, and the pre‑market price fell 4.5%.

AI data‑analytics firm Palantir posted third‑quarter results that beat market expectations and forecast fourth‑quarter revenue above analyst estimates, yet its pre‑market share slipped 6.3%, reflecting investors’ increasingly stringent demands on tech stocks.

The pressure on tech stocks has already pushed the Nasdaq‑100 index, which closed Monday more than 10% below its historical peak, into correction territory. The market is closely watching whether the rapid rise in AI spending by large tech firms will generate sufficient returns, and some companies are issuing debt to fund investments, bringing scrutiny to financing costs amid higher borrowing rates.

However, chip stocks rebounded in pre‑market trading on Tuesday. Nvidia rose 1.6% after four consecutive losing days; AMD, which will report earnings after the close, jumped 2.8%; Marvell and Intel also moved higher. Marvell, which had plunged the day before after announcing the acquisition of Lumentum, saw its pre‑market trend stabilize temporarily.

Politically, attention is on the US midterm elections. Polls and independent analysts suggest Democrats could retake the House, while control of the Senate remains uncertain. Analysts at Societe Generale note that concerns over government spending and deficits continue to heighten market volatility; if Democrats win the House, negotiations over expanded fiscal spending could become more difficult.
Morgan Stanley analysts believe that the election outcome will remove a major source of uncertainty and judge that the market correction that began in June is nearing its end.

In addition, oil prices recovered after a sharp drop the previous trading day, with Middle‑East developments still a market variable. Earnings to be released pre‑market include Pfizer, agribusiness firm ADM and refiner Marathon Petroleum; semiconductor test equipment maker Aehr Test Systems and broadband solutions provider Harmonic each rose 14.6% and 16.1% respectively after raising full‑year revenue forecasts.

items.title: 三星德州二廠傳產能已訂滿！超微拿下多數產能 輝達也下單
items.title_en: Samsung Texas Second Plant Capacity Fully Booked; AMD Secures Majority, Nvidia Also Places Orders
paras: 南韓《每日經濟新聞》周二(3日)引述業界消息指出，三星電子(005930-KS)位於美國德州泰勒市的第二座晶圓代工廠預定11月初正式動工，產能已全數訂滿。新廠將採用2奈米製程，為超微(AMD-US)與輝達(NVDA-US)生產高頻寬記憶體(HBM)所需的基礎晶片，其中多數產量將供應超微。三星對客戶訂單不予置評。
泰勒一廠已取得特斯拉(TSLA-US)的晶片代工合約，二廠則以AI加速器所需的記憶體零組件為主。據報導，二廠面積約270萬平方英尺(約25萬平方公尺)，約為一廠的1.5倍。目前廠區已展開整地等前置作業，預計自2029年2月起安裝生產設備，目標2030年量產。
三星規劃在德州生產的基礎晶片，位於多層堆疊的動態隨機存取記憶體(DRAM)底部，負責在記憶體與圖形處理器(GPU)之間傳輸資料，其設計影響HBM的速度與耗電量。三星目前量產的HBM4採用4奈米基礎晶片，未來則計劃將泰勒二廠生產的2奈米基礎晶片，與南韓製造的DRAM晶片堆疊組合，再以完整的HBM產品交付客戶。
超微占泰勒二廠目前訂單的大多數，至於三星能否進一步擴大輝達訂單，仍取決於下一代產品的代工安排。《每日經濟新聞》指出，輝達希望將旗下客製化記憶體NVHBM的基礎晶片集中委由台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)生產，以縮小不同供應商之間的效能差異，並簡化驗證程序。據報三星正評估自家製程能否生產這類晶片，以便在台積電產能不足時承接訂單。
paras_en: South Korea’s Daily Economic News reported on Tuesday (the 3rd) that Samsung Electronics (005930‑KS) plans to break ground on its second wafer‑fab in Taylor, Texas, in early November, and the entire capacity has already been booked. The new plant will use a 2‑nanometer process to produce the base chips needed for high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) for AMD (AMD‑US) and Nvidia (NVDA‑US), with most of the output slated for AMD. Samsung declined to comment on customer orders.

The Taylor‑1 fab has already secured a chip‑manufacturing contract with Tesla (TSLA‑US), while the second fab will focus on memory components required for AI accelerators. Reported to be about 2.7 million square feet (≈250,000 m²)—roughly 1.5 times the size of the first plant—the site is currently undergoing site‑preparation work, with equipment installation expected to begin in February 2029 and volume production targeted for 2030.

Samsung’s planned base chips in Texas sit at the bottom of the multi‑layer stacked dynamic random‑access memory (DRAM) stack and handle data transfer between the memory and graphics processing units (GPUs). Their design influences HBM speed and power consumption. Samsung currently mass‑produces HBM4 using 4‑nm base chips, and intends to use the 2‑nm base chips from the Taylor‑2 fab stacked with DRAM chips made in South Korea to deliver complete HBM products to customers.

AMD accounts for the majority of current orders at the Taylor‑2 fab. Whether Samsung can further expand Nvidia’s orders will depend on the next‑generation product’s fab arrangements. The Daily Economic News noted that Nvidia wants to concentrate production of its custom memory NVHBM base chips at TSMC (2330‑TW)(TSM‑US) to reduce performance variance across suppliers and simplify validation. Samsung is reportedly evaluating whether its own process can produce such chips to capture orders if TSMC capacity falls short.

items.title: 環球晶擬發行5億美元私募可轉債 美光全數認購
items.title_en: GlobalWafers Plans $500 Million Private Placement Convertible Bonds, Micron to Subscribe Entirely
paras: 矽晶圓大廠環球晶(6488-TW)深化與美國記憶體大廠美光(Micron)(MU-US)策略合作，董事會今(3)日決議通過，擬於5億美元額度內發行10年期私募無擔保可轉換公司債，票面年利率0.5%，並由美光擔任唯一應募人。此次資金合作將結合雙方規劃的10年期長期供應協議(LTA)，進一步強化環球晶美國在地製造布局及先進半導體晶圓供應能力。
環球晶指出，此次私募可轉債是雙方今年7月宣布合作時提及的策略性資金支持進一步推進，透過長期供應與資金合作雙軌並行，將合作關係從既有產品供需延伸至策略性資金合作及長期供應鏈布局，涵蓋未來產能配置、供應穩定性及先進半導體材料供應體系發展。
環球晶表示，私募可轉債除可提供長期資金，也有助於增加資本結構彈性，支持公司美國業務發展及先進晶圓供應能力提升，同時強化美國在地關鍵材料供應能力與供應鏈韌性。
在美國布局方面，環球晶多年來積極推進全球先進製造布局，其中位於美國德州的新廠GlobalWafers America，出貨量已連續4個月創下新高，逐步展現前期投資成果。環球晶指出，結合美國在地製造能力，以及橫跨亞洲、美洲與歐洲的全球製造網絡，可建構更貼近市場、滿足多元客戶需求的供應體系，此次與美光的策略合作，也將進一步銜接客戶長期需求與在地製造布局。
環球晶董事長暨執行長徐秀蘭表示，半導體產業技術創新加速，但支撐創新的先進製造能力，仍需要跨越產業週期持續投入。具備競爭力的供應鏈不僅要回應當前市場需求，也必須提前布局未來技術發展與產能需求。此次與美光深化合作，體現雙方長期累積的互信基礎，也反映半導體產業價值鏈正從傳統供需合作，進一步邁向長期策略協作。
環球晶表示，本次私募可轉債案仍須提交股東會決議，待股東會通過後，將授權董事會視市場狀況及公司營運需求，自股東會決議日起一年內一次辦理，實際發行條件及時程將依後續程序辦理。
paras_en: GlobalWafers (6488-TW), a major silicon wafer manufacturer, deepened its strategic partnership with U.S. memory giant Micron (MU-US). The board resolved today (the 3rd) to issue a 10‑year unsecured private‑placement convertible bond within a $500 million limit, bearing a 0.5% annual coupon, with Micron as the sole subscriber. The financing will be tied to a 10‑year long‑term supply agreement (LTA) the two companies are planning, further strengthening GlobalWafers' U.S. manufacturing footprint and its capacity to supply advanced semiconductor wafers.

GlobalWafers noted that the private‑placement convertible bond is the strategic capital support mentioned when the partnership was announced in July. By pursuing parallel long‑term supply and financing tracks, the collaboration will expand from existing product supply to strategic funding and long‑term supply‑chain planning, covering future capacity allocation, supply stability and the development of advanced semiconductor material supply systems.

GlobalWafers said the private‑placement convertible bond will not only provide long‑term funding but also increase flexibility in its capital structure, supporting the growth of its U.S. business and enhancing its advanced wafer supply capabilities, while bolstering local key‑material supply and supply‑chain resilience in the United States.

Regarding its U.S. footprint, GlobalWafers has been actively advancing its global advanced manufacturing network for years. Its new plant in Texas, GlobalWafers America, has posted record shipments for four consecutive months, gradually demonstrating the payoff of early investments. The company said that combining local U.S. manufacturing capacity with a worldwide network spanning Asia, the Americas and Europe enables a supply system that is closer to the market and can meet diverse customer needs; the strategic partnership with Micron will further align long‑term customer demand with local manufacturing deployment.

Chairman and CEO Hsu Hsiu‑lan said that while technological innovation in the semiconductor industry is accelerating, the advanced manufacturing capability that underpins that innovation still requires sustained investment across industry cycles. A competitive supply chain must not only meet current market demand but also anticipate future technology development and capacity needs. Deepening cooperation with Micron reflects the long‑term trust built between the two firms and signals that the semiconductor value chain is moving from traditional supply‑demand cooperation toward long‑term strategic collaboration.

GlobalWafers said the private‑placement convertible bond still requires shareholder approval. Once approved, the board will be authorized, based on market conditions and operational needs, to execute the issuance within one year of the shareholder meeting. The actual issuance terms and timeline will be determined through subsequent procedures.

items.title: 華爾街憂未來兩年華府陷「政治僵局」 加劇科技股賣壓
items.title_en: Wall Street fears a two‑year political deadlock in Washington will heighten tech‑stock selling pressure
paras: 那斯達克 100 指數跌幅已自高點回檔逾 10%，正式跌入技術性修正區間。市場除了對人工智慧(AI)龐大資本支出的回報速度產生疑慮外，美國期中選舉引發的政治不確定性，也成為重壓華爾街大盤的主因。
市場分析機構 The Kobeissi Letter 於社群平台 X 發文表示，科技股的拋售潮「絕非僅是技術性修正」，投資人正逐步反映未來兩年華府可能出現的「政治僵局」。據預測平台 Polymarket 數據顯示，民主黨掌控眾議院與參議院的機率分別高達 95% 與 77%。
面對國會變天疑慮，美國總統川普已公開示警，若共和黨失去眾議院多數，他將轉變為頻繁行使否決權的「否決先生(Mr. Veto)」。The Kobeissi Letter 強調，「市場極度厭惡不確定性」，川普的表態為未來兩年的政局埋下隱憂。
除了政局變數外，科技巨擘的財報表現並未能安撫市場。Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 因廣告與搜尋業務營收不如預期，創下單日最大跌幅，Meta (META-US)與 Amazon(AMZN-US) 股價均受拖累，英特爾(INTC-US)與 ServiceNow (NOW-US)等業者更因財測失利出現歷史性重挫。
James Investment Research 投資組合經理 Brian Culpepper 對此分析指出：「投資人對於這些企業無休止的巨額支出感到焦慮。我不認為 AI 投資熱潮已經破滅，但它確實走得太快了。」
儘管那斯達克 100 指數單月市值蒸發近 2 兆美元，但多數機構對期中選舉後的長期走勢仍抱持正面態度。摩根士丹利策略師 Mike Wilson 將此次選舉視為能消除市場不確定性的「清算事件」，無論哪個黨派獲勝，都可能對股市有所幫助。
Carson Investment Research 分析師 Ryan Detrick 補充，自 1950 年以來，標普 500 指數在期中選舉後的 11 月至次年 4 月期間全數上漲。富達投資(Fidelity Investments)數據顯示，1938 年以來期中選舉後 12 個月標普 500 指數上漲機率高達 95%。
paras_en: The Nasdaq‑100 index has fallen more than 10% from its recent high, officially entering a technical correction zone. In addition to doubts about the speed of returns on the massive AI capital spending, political uncertainty sparked by the U.S. midterm elections has become a major drag on Wall Street’s broad market.

Market‑analysis firm The Kobeissi Letter posted on X that the tech‑stock sell‑off “is far from being just a technical correction”; investors are gradually pricing in a possible “political deadlock” in Washington over the next two years. Data from the prediction platform Polymarket shows a 95% chance that Democrats will control the House and a 77% chance they will control the Senate.

Facing concerns about a shift in Congress, former President Donald Trump has publicly warned that if Republicans lose the House majority, he will become a frequent user of the veto, dubbing himself “Mr. Veto.” The Kobeissi Letter stresses that “the market loathes uncertainty,” and Trump’s stance adds a lingering risk to the political outlook for the next two years.

Beyond the political variables, the earnings reports of tech giants have failed to soothe the market. Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) posted its biggest one‑day drop after advertising and search revenues fell short of expectations, while Meta (META‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US) stocks were also dragged down. Intel (INTC‑US) and ServiceNow (NOW‑US) suffered historic declines after disappointing forecasts.

James Investment Research portfolio manager Brian Culpepper analyzed, “Investors are anxious about these companies’ endless massive spending. I don’t think the AI investment boom is over, but it certainly moved too fast.”

Although the Nasdaq‑100’s market cap evaporated nearly $2 trillion this month, most institutions remain upbeat about the long‑term trajectory after the midterms. Morgan Stanley strategist Mike Wilson views the election as a “clearing event” that could remove market uncertainty, and regardless of which party wins, it may ultimately benefit equities.

Carson Investment Research analyst Ryan Detrick added that since 1950 the S&P 500 has risen in every November‑to‑April period following a midterm election. Fidelity Investments data shows that since 1938 the probability of the S&P 500 gaining over the 12 months after a midterm is as high as 95%.

items.title: Marvell收購Lumentum達成光、電整合 集邦：有望挑戰Broadcom領導地位
items.title_en: Marvell's Acquisition of Lumentum Achieves Optical‑Electronic Integration; TrendForce: May Challenge Broadcom's Leadership
paras: Marvell(MRVL-TS)正式宣布將收購光通訊大廠Lumentum(LITE-US)，兩家公司的董事會已於11月2日通過這筆交易，但此案仍待雙方股東及各國監管機關核准。TrendForce表示，若併購案成立，除了有助Marvell補足光學業務版圖，與Lumentum攜手提出更佳的次世代光互連技術服務，目前光通訊產業由Broadcom(AVGO-US)強勢領導的局面也將出現變化。
根據TrendForce估算，2026年Marvell、Lumentum的有線通訊半導體市場(semiconductor wired communication)營收市占分居第四、第八名，合併之後，兩家在該應用的市占率將上升至6.4%左右，僅次於NVIDIA和Broadcom。
TrendForce分析，在AI光通訊與互連領域中，Broadcom擁有Tomahawk Switch交換晶片、DSP（數位訊號處理器）等半導體晶片以及EML與CW Laser光源等元件，是同時具備「光」與「電」能力的領導廠商。Marvell則以「電」為主、Lumentum著重「光」，兩者合併後將同時具有光電元件與半導體IC能力，打破Broadcom的領導地位。
TrendForce表示，在現行的光通訊關鍵零組件當中，Lumentum為重要雷射光源供應商之一，Marvell則供應DSP與相關光通訊應用晶片。合併案若能通過，對NVIDIA與其他雲端服務大廠（CSP）而言，則有機會降低對Broadcom方案的依賴，並獲得更多的完整電光互連方案，以維持採購彈性。

從技術的角度觀察，該合併案亦可視作Marvell為CPO/NPO世代的Scale-in 與 Scale-up光互連提前布局。Marvell補上自身最欠缺的InP雷射光源後，可形成「一電一光」的光引擎整合能力。合併後可望將Marvell的先進CMOS晶片設計、高速交換晶片、電光互連、矽光子與客製化XPU能力，結合Lumentum的InP高效能雷射、光收發模組、光路交換（OCS），提供涵蓋晶片、光引擎、光源與模組的整合方案，透過共同設計與預先驗證，縮短客戶開發及導入時程。

然而，此案尚待美國、中國監管機關批准。TrendForce觀察，中國光模組廠是全球800G／1.6T光模組的主要供應商，高度依賴Marvell的DSP以及Lumentum等業者提供的EML／CW雷射光源。由於Lumentum旗下也有光模組廠Cloud Light，合併通過後後若限制競爭對手取得關鍵光源、綁售DSP與雷射，或優先供應旗下公司，將直接削弱中國模組廠的競爭力。因此，合併案是否會影響中國光模組廠商的生存空間，估計將會是中國政府的審查重點。
paras_en: Marvell (MRVL-TS) officially announced it will acquire optical communications giant Lumentum (LITE-US). The boards of both companies approved the deal on November 2, but it still requires approval from shareholders and regulators in various countries. TrendForce says that if the merger is completed, it will not only help Marvell fill gaps in its optical business and partner with Lumentum to offer better next‑generation optical interconnect services, but also alter the current optical communications market, which is strongly led by Broadcom (AVGO-US).

According to TrendForce estimates, in 2026 Marvell and Lumentum will rank fourth and eighth respectively in the wired‑communication semiconductor market, and after the merger their combined market share in this application will rise to about 6.4%, trailing only NVIDIA and Broadcom.

TrendForce analysis notes that in the AI optical‑communication and interconnect space Broadcom possesses both “optical” and “electrical” capabilities with its Tomahawk Switch chips, DSPs, and components such as EML and CW lasers, making it the leading vendor. Marvell is primarily an “electrical” player, while Lumentum focuses on “optical.” Their combination would give them both optical components and semiconductor IC capabilities, potentially breaking Broadcom’s leadership.

TrendForce points out that among current key optical‑communication components, Lumentum is a major laser source supplier and Marvell provides DSPs and related optical‑communication application chips. If the merger clears, NVIDIA and other cloud service providers could reduce reliance on Broadcom solutions and gain more complete electro‑optical interconnect options, preserving procurement flexibility.

From a technology perspective, the deal can be seen as Marvell’s early‑stage “Scale‑in” and “Scale‑up” positioning for CPO/NPO‑generation optical interconnects. By adding the InP laser sources it lacks, Marvell would achieve a “one‑electric‑one‑optical” integrated light‑engine capability. Post‑merger, Marvell’s advanced CMOS chip design, high‑speed switch chips, electro‑optical interconnects, silicon photonics and custom XPU expertise could be combined with Lumentum’s high‑efficiency InP lasers, transceiver modules and optical‑circuit‑switch (OCS) technology to deliver integrated solutions covering chips, light engines, sources and modules, shortening customer development and deployment cycles through joint design and pre‑validation.

However, the transaction still awaits approval from U.S. and Chinese regulators. TrendForce observes that Chinese optical‑module manufacturers, which are major suppliers of global 800G/1.6T optical modules, heavily depend on Marvell’s DSPs and laser sources such as EML/CW from Lumentum. Since Lumentum also owns the optical‑module maker Cloud Light, a merger that restricts competitors’ access to key lasers, ties DSP and laser sales, or gives priority to affiliated companies would directly weaken Chinese module makers. Consequently, the impact of the merger on the survival of Chinese optical‑module firms is expected to be a focal point of Chinese government review.

items.title: 千億美元併購內幕曝光！傳邁威爾、Lumentum交易拍板前 先徵詢輝達黃仁勳意見並獲力挺
items.title_en: $110 Billion Merger Unveiled! Before Finalizing the Marvell‑Lumentum Deal, They Sought Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s Input and Got His Back
paras: IC設計巨頭邁威爾(MRVL-US)周一(2日)敲定以1150億美元收購光學元件製造商Lumentum(LITE-US)，為史上規模第二大的科技業交易，據說兩家公司在成交前曾徵詢輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳的意見並獲得支持，顯示身為人工智慧(AI)領導廠商的輝達，正在資料中心擴建催生更快速光連接需求的過程中，鼓勵關鍵供應商整併
知情人士披露，邁威爾執行長Matthew Murphy與Lumentum執行長Michael Hurlston在交易宣布前，曾透過電話徵詢黃仁勳的看法。輝達是訓練及執行大型語言模型所需晶片的主要供應商，今年稍早已分別投資邁威爾與Lumentum各20億美元。
Hurlston周一(2日)稍早接受Fox Business訪問時說：「我認為輝達的反應非常正面。我們認為，透過這次合併，實際上能加速供應更多產品給輝達。」

AI帶動大型併購 邁威爾整合客製化晶片與光學元件

這項交易凸顯AI正在推動企業併購活動，邁威爾將成為垂直整合程度更高的高速連接設備供應商，這類設備在科技業競爭打造AI運算叢集的情況下，重要性正與日俱增。
知情人士表示，兩家公司自今年夏季開始討論合併可能性，但只在雙方之間談判。邁威爾原先計劃配合Lumentum預定本周四公布財報時一併宣布此交易，但在消息外洩之後決定提前公布。
邁威爾執行長Murphy在討論這項交易的投資人電話會議中說：「我和Mike(Lumentum執行長)對世界未來的走向有非常相近的願景。我們在專業與私人層面都維持長期關係，Lumentum是邁威爾的重要客戶。我們與對方團隊有很多互動，這筆交易就這樣促成了。」
然而兩家公司原先希望擴大AI基建布局的交易正式公布後，股價卻同步重挫，Lumentum暴跌18.6%，成為當天標普500表現最差的成分股，邁威爾下挫12.7%，創2000年10月以來最糟三日跌幅，反映市場開始質疑交易條件、整合效益以及監管審查過關的問題。
paras_en: IC design giant Marvell (MRVL‑US) sealed a $115 billion acquisition of optical components maker Lumentum (LITE‑US) on Monday (the 2nd), the second‑largest tech deal ever. Sources say the two firms consulted Nvidia (NVDA‑US) CEO Jensen Huang before closing and received his endorsement, indicating that Nvidia, the AI leader, is encouraging key suppliers to consolidate as data‑center expansion drives demand for faster optical links.

Insiders disclosed that Marvell CEO Matthew Murphy and Lumentum CEO Michael Hurlston phoned Jensen Huang for his view before the deal was announced. Nvidia, a primary supplier of chips for training and running large language models, earlier this year invested $2 billion each in Marvell and Lumentum.
Hurlston told Fox Business on Monday morning, "I think Nvidia’s reaction was very positive. We believe this merger will actually accelerate getting more products to Nvidia."

AI‑driven mega‑M&A: Marvell integrates custom chips with optics. The transaction highlights how AI is fueling corporate M&A activity, turning Marvell into a more vertically integrated high‑speed connectivity supplier—a class of equipment whose importance is growing as tech firms race to build AI compute clusters.

Sources said the two companies began discussing a possible merger in the summer, but negotiations were limited to the parties themselves. Marvell had originally planned to announce the deal alongside its earnings release on Thursday, but after the news leaked they moved the announcement forward.

Marvell CEO Murphy said during an investor call, "Mike and I share a very similar vision for the world’s future. We have a long‑standing relationship both professionally and personally; Lumentum is an important Marvell customer. We interact a lot with their team, and that’s how this deal came together."

However, after the companies formally announced the deal meant to expand AI infrastructure, both stocks plunged. Lumentum fell 18.6%, making it the worst‑performing S&P 500 component that day, while Marvell dropped 12.7%, marking its steepest three‑day decline since October 2000, as the market began questioning the deal’s terms, integration benefits, and regulatory approval prospects.

items.title: 投資人只注意到科技股大跌 但美股多數股票仍上漲
items.title_en: Investors Only Notice Tech Stock Plunge, Yet Most US Stocks Still Rise
paras: 美國股市周一(2日)原本早盤急漲後，漲勢快速瓦解，人工智慧(AI)與科技股在上周遭拋售之後持續疲軟，成為市場焦點，從而掩蓋了華爾街多數股票的漲勢。
在指數表現方面，標普500指數早盤一度上揚1.1%，但隨後回吐全部漲幅，終場下跌0.5%或38.67點，收於7,541.40點；那斯達克綜合指數下挫1.1%或272.68點，收25,164.32點；道瓊指數逆勢上漲213點或0.4%，收51,983.98點。
儘管主要指數走勢分化，標普500指數成分股中仍有近七成上漲，主要受惠於布蘭特原油期貨價格大跌7.6%至每桶104.77美元，緩解了企業燃料成本壓力。原油價格自伊朗戰爭爆發前至今，持續在每桶70至120美元之間大幅震盪。
科技族群則面臨高度不確定性。市場持續擔憂大型科技公司投入數千億美元建設AI資料中心，恐難以實現相應的生產力與獲利效益。Alphabet(GOOGL-US)因自由現金流減少及搜尋業務成長放緩，引發市場對AI削弱核心獲利的疑慮，股價在上周四暴跌逾12%，創歷來最大單日跌幅，周一雖一度開高2.6%，終場仍轉跌0.3%。
晶片巨頭輝達(NVDA-US)早盤一度上漲2.6%，最終仍收低1.3%。此外，Marvell Technology(MRVL-US)宣布將以換股方式收購AI光學元件廠Lumentum(LITE-US)，導致Marvell股價重挫12.7%，Lumentum更暴跌18.6%。
相較於科技股走低，傳統產業與航空旅遊類股表現強勁。聯合航空(UAL-US)大漲4.8%，西南航空(LUV-US)上漲3.6%，嘉年華郵輪(CCL-US)上漲4.2%。
針對這波市場輪動，Nationwide 首席市場策略師Mark Hackett 表示，雖然指數表面平穩，但底層波動劇烈
；若科技股連續數月劇烈下跌，不論在數學計算或市場心理上都將變得非常困難。
Edward Jones 資深全球投資策略師Angelo Kourkafas 指出，投資人希望維持持股，但正試圖降低AI集中度風險，轉向多元收益來源。但他警告，若超大規模雲端業者（hyperscalers）開始削減支撐經濟的資本支出，恐引發廣泛的避險情緒。
paras_en: US equities on Monday (the 2nd) saw an early surge that quickly unraveled; AI and tech stocks, still weak after last week’s sell‑off, dominated headlines and masked the broader rally on Wall Street.

In terms of index performance, the S&P 500 rose as much as 1.1% in early trading before giving back all gains and closing down 0.5% or 38.67 points at 7,541.40; the Nasdaq Composite fell 1.1% or 272.68 points to 25,164.32; the Dow Jones rose against the trend by 213 points or 0.4% to 51,983.98.

Despite the divergence among the major indices, nearly 70% of S&P 500 constituents posted gains, helped largely by Brent crude futures plunging 7.6% to $104.77 a barrel, easing corporate fuel‑cost pressures. Oil prices have been swinging wildly between $70 and $120 a barrel since the outbreak of the Iran war.

Tech stocks faced high uncertainty. Markets remain worried that large tech firms’ multibillion‑dollar investments in AI data centers may not deliver the expected productivity and profit gains. Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) saw its stock tumble more than 12% on Thursday after a drop in free cash flow and slowing search‑business growth, sparking doubts about AI eroding core earnings; it opened up 2.6% on Monday but still finished down 0.3%.

Chip giant Nvidia (NVDA‑US) was up 2.6% in early trade but ended the session down 1.3%. Meanwhile, Marvell Technology (MRVL‑US) announced a stock‑swap acquisition of AI optics maker Lumentum (LITE‑US), sending Marvell shares plunging 12.7% and Lumentum tumbling 18.6%.

In contrast to the tech decline, traditional sectors and travel‑airline stocks were strong. United Airlines (UAL‑US) jumped 4.8%, Southwest Airlines (LUV‑US) rose 3.6%, and Carnival Cruise (CCL‑US) gained 4.2%.
Commenting on the market rotation, Nationwide chief market strategist Mark Hackett said that while the indices look stable on the surface, underlying volatility is intense;
He added that if tech stocks keep falling sharply for months, it will become extremely difficult both mathematically and psychologically for the market.

Edward Jones senior global investment strategist Angelo Kourkafas noted investors want to hold positions but are trying to reduce AI concentration risk by diversifying income sources. He warned that if hyperscale cloud providers start cutting capital spending that supports the economy, it could trigger broad‑based risk‑off sentiment.

items.title: Anthropic更新招股書揭驚人財務數字！背負近9000億美元算力支出
paras: 人工智慧（AI）新創公司Anthropic最新更新提交給美國證券交易委員會（SEC）的S-1上市申請文件，進一步揭露公司今年前三季的財務狀況。數據顯示，Anthropic前三季營收達332.4億美元，年增約12倍，但同期淨虧損也擴大至1,040億美元。更引發市場關注的是，公司已簽署的採購承諾及租賃協議，涉及支出總額高達約8,954億美元，幾乎全數與算力及基礎設施有關。
Anthropic上週才首次公開上市申請文件，當時僅揭露今年上半年的財務數據。此次更新補入第三季業績，讓外界得以進一步了解這家AI新創公司的營運規模與資金需求。
財務數據顯示，Anthropic今年前三季總營收達332.4億美元，較去年同期大幅成長約1,200%。其中，第三季單季營收約170億美元，年增約1,127%。
不過，若觀察季度成長速度，Anthropic的營收動能已出現放緩。第三季營收季增約47%，遠低於第一季的132%及第二季的144%。
獲利方面，Anthropic前三季淨虧損高達1,040億美元，遠高於去年同期的251億美元；單計第三季，淨虧損便達232.9億美元。
值得注意的是，這筆龐大虧損主要來自可轉換票據及衍生負債的公允價值變動，並非全數來自日常營運支出。

近9000億美元算力承諾曝光 基礎建設成本急速攀升

比起營收與虧損數字，Anthropic在上市文件中揭露的基礎設施支出承諾，更讓市場感受到AI產業擴張所需的資金規模。
文件顯示，Anthropic已簽署的採購承諾及租賃協議，涉及總支出約8,954億美元，其中幾乎全部與算力及基礎設施有關。
今年前九個月，Anthropic的算力及基礎設施支出增加144億美元，年增329%。公司也在文件中坦言，隨著算力與基礎設施規模持續擴大，相關成本也將同步增加。
為支撐大型AI模型的運作，Anthropic目前大部分算力仰賴亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、Google(GOOGL-US) 及SpaceX(SPCX-US) 提供，同時也透過新興雲端服務商（Neocloud）持續擴充運算資源。
然而，Anthropic積極擴張算力之際，華爾街對AI基礎建設投資的疑慮也正在升高。
市場擔心，若利率持續走高，資料中心開發商及新興雲端業者將更難承擔龐大的債務負擔。微軟（Microsoft）、Alphabet及亞馬遜（Amazon）上週公布的財報，也進一步加深投資人對AI資本支出的憂慮。
科技巨頭持續大舉投入AI基礎建設，龐大的資本支出正逐漸侵蝕企業自由現金流。投資人開始質疑，市場新增算力的供應速度，是否足以跟上Anthropic等AI業者不斷擴大的需求。

Anthropic上市進度超前OpenAI 風險揭露逾90頁

在上市進度方面，Anthropic正試圖搶在競爭對手OpenAI之前完成公開上市。Anthropic執行長阿莫戴（Dario Amodei）當年曾帶領核心研究人員離開OpenAI創立公司，如今兩家企業已成為AI產業正面競爭的對手。
OpenAI則已於今年6月秘密提交上市申請，高層透露，目標是在2027年掛牌上市。
除了財務及基礎建設支出，Anthropic此次更新的招股書也大篇幅揭露潛在風險。文件中，風險因素相關內容超過90頁，涵蓋可能面臨的政治阻力、複雜的算力基礎建設需求，以及如何在AI安全與商業變現之間取得平衡等挑戰。
Anthropic共同創辦人在文件中表示，協助全球理解AI可能帶來的風險，在AI模型引發危害時盡力阻止或降低影響，並與政府及產業共同從整體社會層面解決相關問題，是他們個人的責任。

items.title: 美股盤前／蘋果跌4.5%、Palantir挫6.3%！晶片股反彈，期貨漲跌互見
items.title_en: US Stocks Pre‑Market: Apple Down 4.5%, Palantir Slides 6.3% – Chip Stocks Rebound, Futures Mixed
paras: 2026年11月03日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股週二（3日）盤前，主要指數期貨漲跌互見。蘋果因記憶體成本上升、毛利率承壓，股價下跌4.5%；Palantir(PLTR-US)即使財報與營收展望優於預期，仍下挫6.3%。不過，輝達、AMD等晶片股反彈，支撐那斯達克100期貨走高，市場同時等待美國期中選舉結果。
截稿前，道瓊期貨下跌219點、跌幅0.42%；標普500期貨上漲0.02%，那斯達克100期貨上漲0.46%。
蘋果成為最新一家財報未能帶動股價的大型科技公司。公司警告，記憶體晶片成本將持續上升，壓抑涵蓋年底假期旺季季度的毛利率，盤前股價下跌4.5%。
AI數據分析軟體業者Palantir第3季業績超越市場預期，並預估第4季營收高於分析師預期，但盤前股價仍下跌6.3%，反映投資人對科技股的要求持續提高。
科技股近期承受的壓力，已使那斯達克100指數在週一收盤時，較歷史收盤高點下跌逾10%，進入修正區間。市場日益關注大型科技公司的AI支出快速攀升，能否帶來足夠回報；部分業者透過發債支應投資，也讓借款成本上升下的資金壓力受到檢視。
不過，晶片股週二盤前出現反彈。輝達在連跌四個交易日後上漲1.6%；即將於盤後公布財報的AMD上漲2.8%，Marvell與英特爾也走高。其中，Marvell前一交易日才因宣布收購Lumentum而重挫，盤前走勢暫時回穩。
政治面則聚焦美國期中選舉。民調與無黨派分析人士傾向認為，民主黨有望奪回眾議院，參議院控制權仍有變數。法國興業銀行分析師指出，政府支出與赤字疑慮持續加劇市場波動；若民主黨取得眾議院控制權，未來擴大財政支出的協商可能更加困難。
摩根士丹利分析師則認為，選舉結果出爐有助消除一項重大不確定性，並判斷自6月開始的美股修正已接近尾聲。
此外，原油價格在前一交易日大跌後回升，中東局勢仍是市場變數。財報方面，輝瑞、農產品業者ADM與煉油商Marathon Petroleum預定盤前公布業績；半導體測試設備商Aehr Test Systems與寬頻解決方案業者Harmonic調高全年營收預測後，盤前分別上漲14.6%與16.1%。
